CM.hyperparameter_rule: most frequent selection across the paper's 25 outer folds (15/25)
CM.feature_definitions: CodeSniff extraction (app/codesniff/extract.py): lizard-based cc (DesigniteJava-compatible), declaration pc, lizard NLOC; paper's compute() for the other features

app_cv.protocol: the paper's 25 project-grouped splits (5 repeats x 5 folds), fixed hyperparameters
app_cv.caveat: hyperparameters are the modal choice of the paper's nested tuning over these same folds, so this estimate is slightly optimistic; the paper's nested-CV value (paper_cv) is the one CodeSniff quotes

feature_agreement_with_designite.note: upper bounds: the alignment picks, among overloads in a snippet file, the method matching the stored pc (then cc); the unbiased rates are in lizard_agreement.json

CM.intended_use: rank borderline methods for human review; not a verdict

LPL.hyperparameter_rule: most frequent selection across the paper's 25 outer folds (12/25)
LPL.probability: SVC(probability=True): Platt scaling; the paper's class rule is the decision-function sign

training_data.set: unanimous entities, consistency-filtered; R5: pc = 3 block removed
